identity.legal_long_name: ABC — Allan's Breakfast Club & Wine Bar
identity.tagline: Day drinking. Good times. Fish focused. Always.
identity.google_description: Popular brunches with eggs, bagels & craft coffee, plus German wines, at a trendy modern cafe/bar.
identity.founded_evidence: 10-year anniversary flyer posted for 6 Sept 2026 (party date since moved, see events.upcoming); Facebook page created 20 Dec 2014.

contact.legacy_domain_status: 301-redirects to allansbreakfastclub.geo.io, which returns HTTP 403. Treat as dead; point at allansabc.com.
contact.phone_note: No phone number published on Google or Facebook. Bookings are handled via Instagram DM per their posts. NEEDS_CONFIRMATION.

caveats: Google's hours cover the brunch service only. Their own posts advertise a Bondi Fish Evening 'from 6pm till late' and a bar 'open full blast all day' on Fridays — evening hours are not reflected in the Google listing.
They frequently extend hours for sun, events and holidays ('CHANGE OF PLAN — THE SUN WILL BE SHINNING SO WE WILL BE OPEN ALL DAY NO BREAK'). Treat published hours as a baseline, not a guarantee.
NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: whether Tue/Wed closure is permanent or seasonal.

practical.cash_only_note: 'Cash-only' is flagged in Google's payment attributes and is the 3rd most-mentioned term across 1,550 reviews (50 mentions). This is the single most important practical detail to put on the website — it is the most common complaint driver.
practical.reservations_note: 'YES WE TAKE BOOKINGS' — Instagram, Apr 2026. Brunch reservations recommended. Usually a wait without one.
practical.delivery_note: Listed on Wolt. Also 'Curbside pickup' on Facebook.
practical.parking: Paid street parking, usually difficult to find a space

offering.positioning: Australian-Aussie brunch culture crossed with French bistro and Mediterranean apéro. Café and day-drinking spot with a terrace.
